Keeping a family matter private can be a complex issue, especially when it involves a close relative asking you to do so. On one hand, respecting their request can help maintain trust and avoid potential conflict within the family. On the other hand, withholding information from someone who deserves to know the truth can lead to feelings of guilt, anxiety, or even damage to your relationship with that person.
